The People Behind the Work

Our Staff

A small, hands-on team with practical experience, clear priorities, and a suspiciously high ratio of dogs to humans.

Meet the Team

Small Team. Serious Follow-Through.

You work directly with the person responsible for your project, supported by an exceptionally attentive canine leadership team.

The Human

Celina

Owner & Operator

Celina leads every client relationship and project from first conversation through launch and ongoing support. She combines practical farm experience with a clear-eyed approach to technology, building websites and tools that solve real problems without unnecessary complexity.

Operations

Argos

Head of Project Management

Argos keeps a close eye on schedules, priorities, and anyone who appears to be standing still for too long. His management style is focused, direct, and strongly in favour of regular outdoor status meetings.

People & Culture

Luna

Head of Morale & Cuteness

Luna makes sure the workday stays balanced, spirits remain high, and no good idea goes uncelebrated. She brings curiosity, enthusiasm, and a well-timed reminder that every difficult problem benefits from a short break.

Security

Max

Head of Security — Cyber & Otherwise

Max oversees perimeter checks, unexpected visitors, and anything that looks even slightly unusual. His approach to security is proactive, thorough, and backed by an impressive bark-first escalation policy.
